items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I know the last band he played with was on Sting or Captain. Do you know what band that was? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Pishon's band.

ctx.x: Oh, and you want to think of something you can't. You can't think all the names of them places. I can't remember the days. There was a band that he played with besides the Desdune band. Some of the bands he played with. I don't know. Was that Desdune died, Angel? Yeah, Desdune died. Desdune died, yeah. And he played, well, all I can remember is playing with him out in Texas. Well, he was with honeycomb, the tenor player was his band. That's his brother, Matt Brown. Yeah, his brother. Mr. Steevio's band. I mean,…
Pishon's band. He played from here to New York and then finally stayed in New York. So I never could keep up with him no more in the bands.
